findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0 even though the source schedule total reports Total Investments at 227.49% of net assets.

rationale: The raw SOI schedule includes a % of Net Assets column and its current-period Total Investments row reports 227.49%. The flagged artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%, so the pipeline failed to extract or map the schedule percentage values rather than the source being zero.
